profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer
profile.summary:
•	Over 11+ years of experience in Web Application development using various technology stack.
•	Professional experience in all phases of SDLC (analysis, design, development, testing and maintenance).
•	Experience working in Agile/SAFe environment with pair programming technique.
•	Experience in development of various client-server and web-based applications with n-tier architecture using .Net Core, .NET Framework, ASP.Net, C#, RESTful Web API, JavaScript, Angular, JQuery and MS SQL, SSIS, SignalR, Solace, Selenium, QMetry and Private Azure Cloud.
•	Excellent hands-on experience in Database Design and Database Programming using SQL Server and creating database objects like Stored Procedure, Views, Triggers, Joins and Functions including strong database performance optimization experience.
•	Familiar with using and integrating third-party tools with the application using exposed APIs and Adapters.
•	Hands on experience with Finance, Telecommunication and Manufacturing domains.
•	Versatile team player with excellent communication, presentation & interpersonal skills.
•	Proven logical & analytical abilities to see both the business & technical sides of a problem.
•	Demonstrated ability to acquire technical & domain knowledge & skills rapidly with self-learning attitude.
